/- If $R$ is a valuation ring, then an $R$-module $A$ is torsion-free if it is flat.-/
theorem noZeroSMulDivisors_of_flat {R A : Type} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [ValuationRing R] [AddCommGroup A]
    [Module R A] [Module.Flat R A] : NoZeroSMulDivisors R A := by
  refine ⟨fun {r a} h => ?_⟩
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · left; exact hr
  · right
    -- Multiplication by r on R is injective
    let f : R →ₗ[R] R := LinearMap.mulLeft R r
    have hf : Function.Injective f := by
      intro x y hxy
      simp only [f, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply] at hxy
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hr hxy
    -- rTensor preserves injectivity by flatness
    have hrT : Function.Injective (LinearMap.rTensor A f) :=
      Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap f hf
    -- Now transfer through TensorProduct.lid
    let lid := TensorProduct.lid R A
    have key : Function.Injective (fun x : A => r • x) := by
      intro x y hxy
      have h1 : lid ((LinearMap.rTensor A f) ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] x)) = r • x := by
        simp [f, lid, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
              TensorProduct.lid_tmul]
      have h2 : lid ((LinearMap.rTensor A f) ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] y)) = r • y := by
        simp [f, lid, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
              TensorProduct.lid_tmul]
      have h3 : lid ((LinearMap.rTensor A f) ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] x)) =
                lid ((LinearMap.rTensor A f) ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] y)) := by
        rw [h1, h2]; exact hxy
      have h4 : (LinearMap.rTensor A f) ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
                (LinearMap.rTensor A f) ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] y) :=
        lid.injective h3
      have h5 : ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] x : TensorProduct R R A) = (1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] y := hrT h4
      have h6 : lid ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] x) = lid ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] y) := by rw [h5]
      simpa [lid, TensorProduct.lid_tmul] using h6
    have hh : r • a = r • (0 : A) := by rw [smul_zero]; exact h
    exact key hh

theorem exists_isMaximal_atPrime_of_bijective {k R A : Type} [Field k] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra k R]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra k A] [IsScalarTower k R A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (h : Function.Bijective <| (IsLocalRing.residue A).comp (algebraMap k A))
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S A] :
    ∃ n : Ideal R, ∃ hn : n.IsMaximal, IsLocalization.AtPrime A n := by
  set m : Ideal A := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A with hm
  set n : Ideal R := m.comap (algebraMap R A) with hn_def
  have hn_prime : n.IsPrime := Ideal.IsMaximal.comap_isPrime _ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A)

  have hS_le : S ≤ n.primeCompl := by
    intro s hs
    intro hsn

    have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap R A s) := IsLocalization.map_units A ⟨s, hs⟩
    have : algebraMap R A s ∈ m := hsn
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A).ne_top
      (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ this hunit)
  -- Show n is maximal
  have hn_max : n.IsMaximal := by
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · -- n ≠ ⊤
      intro htop
      have h1 : (1 : R) ∈ n := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
      have h2 : algebraMap R A 1 ∈ m := h1
      rw [map_one] at h2
      exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A).ne_top
        (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h2 isUnit_one)

      intro J hJ
      by_contra hJtop

      -- The composition k → R → A → A/m is bijective.
      -- Pick j ∈ J \ n. Then algebraMap R A j ∉ m, so it's a unit in A.
      -- We'll show 1 ∈ J.
      obtain ⟨j, hjJ, hjn⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hJ
      -- j ∉ n means algebraMap R A j ∉ m
      have hja : algebraMap R A j ∉ m := hjn

        (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).not.mp hja |> fun hh => by
          rcases isUnit_or_eq_zero (algebraMap R A j) with hu | hz
          · exact hu
          · exfalso; apply hh
            rw [hz]; exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).zero_mem
      -- Now use bijectivity of k → A/m to find c ∈ k with image equal to residue of algebraMap R A j
      have hbij := h
      -- residue (algebraMap R A j) is in image of k → A/m
      set φ : k → IsLocalRing.ResidueField A := (IsLocalRing.residue A).comp (algebraMap k A)
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hbij.surjective (IsLocalRing.residue A (algebraMap R A j))
      -- c ≠ 0 since residue (algebraMap R A j) ≠ 0 (as algebraMap R A j is a unit hence not in m)
      have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := by
        intro hc0
        rw [hc0] at hc
        simp [φ] at hc
        -- hc : 0 = residue ...
        have : algebraMap R A j ∈ m := by
          rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
          exact hc.symm
        exact hja this
      -- So c is a unit in k
      have hc_unit : IsUnit c := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hc_ne
      -- Now algebraMap k A c - algebraMap R A j is in m
      have hdiff : algebraMap k A c - algebraMap R A j ∈ m := by
        rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
        rw [map_sub]
        have := hc
        simp [φ, Function.comp] at this
        rw [this]
        ring
      -- Need to express algebraMap k A c via the scalar tower
      -- algebraMap k A = (algebraMap R A) ∘ (algebraMap k R)
      have htower : algebraMap k A c = algebraMap R A (algebraMap k R c) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
      rw [htower] at hdiff
      rw [← map_sub] at hdiff
      -- So algebraMap k R c - j ∈ n (since its image in A is in m)
      have hin_n : algebraMap k R c - j ∈ n := hdiff
      have hin_J : algebraMap k R c - j ∈ J := hJ.le hin_n
      -- So algebraMap k R c = (algebraMap k R c - j) + j ∈ J
      have hcJ : algebraMap k R c ∈ J := by
        have : algebraMap k R c = (algebraMap k R c - j) + j := by ring
        rw [this]
        exact J.add_mem hin_J hjJ
      -- algebraMap k R c is a unit in R since c is a unit in k
      have hcR_unit : IsUnit (algebraMap k R c) := hc_unit.map (algebraMap k R)
      -- So J = ⊤
      exact hJtop (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hcJ hcR_unit)

  -- Use that S ≤ n.primeCompl and every element of n.primeCompl is a unit in A
  have hcompl_units : ∀ t ∈ n.primeCompl, IsUnit (algebraMap R A t) := by
    intro t ht
    have : algebraMap R A t ∉ m := ht
    rcases isUnit_or_eq_zero (algebraMap R A t) with hu | hz
    · exact hu
    · exfalso; apply this; rw [hz]; exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).zero_mem
  exact IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_submonoid_le _ _ S n.primeCompl hS_le
    (fun ⟨t, ht⟩ => hcompl_units t ht)

/--Let \( R \) be a commutative ring. If all submodules of finitely generated free modules over
\( R \) are free over \( R \), then \( R \) is a PID.-/
theorem isPrincipalIdealRing_of_forall_free {R : Type} [CommRing R]
    (h : ∀ (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R M],
      ∀ (N : Submodule R M), Module.Free R N) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing R := by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hsub | hnt
  · refine ⟨fun I => ⟨⟨0, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    ext x
    simp [Subsingleton.elim x (0:R), Submodule.zero_mem]
  · refine ⟨fun I => ?_⟩
    haveI hfree : Module.Free R I := h R I
    set κ := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R I with hκdef
    set B : Basis κ R I := Module.Free.chooseBasis R I with hBdef
    have hsubκ : Subsingleton κ := by
      by_contra hns
      rw [not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial] at hns
      obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := hns
      let a : R := (B i : R)
      let b : R := (B j : R)
      let f : κ →₀ R := Finsupp.single i b - Finsupp.single j a
      have htot : (Finsupp.total κ I R B) f = 0 := by
        show (Finsupp.total κ I R B) (Finsupp.single i b - Finsupp.single j a) = 0
        rw [map_sub, Finsupp.total_single, Finsupp.total_single]
        apply Subtype.ext
        show (b • (B i : I) - a • (B j : I) : I).val = (0 : I).val
        show b • (B i : R) - a • (B j : R) = 0
        change b * (B i : R) - a * (B j : R) = 0
        change b * a - a * b = 0
        ring
      have hf0 : f = 0 := by
        have hli := B.linearIndependent
        rw [linearIndependent_iff] at hli
        exact hli f htot
      have hfi : f i = b := by
        simp [f, Finsupp.single_apply, hij.symm]
      have hb0 : b = 0 := by
        have := congrArg (fun g : κ →₀ R => g i) hf0
        simp [hfi] at this
        exact this
      have : (B j : R) = 0 := hb0
      have hBj : B j = 0 := Subtype.ext this
      exact B.ne_zero j hBj
    by_cases hemp : IsEmpty κ
    · refine ⟨⟨0, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [Submodule.span_zero_singleton]
      ext x
      refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => hx ▸ I.zero_mem⟩
      have : (⟨x, hx⟩ : I) = 0 := by
        have hr := B.total_repr ⟨x, hx⟩
        have : (B.repr ⟨x, hx⟩) = 0 := by
          ext k; exact hemp.elim k
        rw [this, map_zero] at hr
        exact hr.symm
      exact congrArg Subtype.val this
    · rw [not_isEmpty_iff] at hemp
      haveI : Nonempty κ := hemp
      haveI : Unique κ := uniqueOfSubsingleton (Classical.arbitrary κ)
      refine ⟨⟨(B default : R), ?_⟩⟩
      ext x
      refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
      · have hr := B.total_repr ⟨x, hx⟩
        set c : R := B.repr ⟨x, hx⟩ default
        have hrepr : B.repr ⟨x, hx⟩ = Finsupp.single default c := by
          apply Finsupp.ext
          intro k
          have hk : k = default := Unique.eq_default k
          subst hk
          simp [c]
        rw [hrepr, Finsupp.total_single] at hr
        have hxeq : x = c • (B default : R) := by
          have := congrArg Subtype.val hr
          exact this.symm
        rw [hxeq]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
      · rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hx
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hx
        rw [← hc]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (B default).property
